registered_text: The complete experiment code, configurations, source data, split and seed manifests, environment specification, checkpoints, predictions, propensity-logged trajectories, statistical outputs and figure/table generators are available in the CROSS-MORSE GitHub repository at https://github.com/VKHS/CR-9. The repository provides the one-command reconstruction of every reported table and figure and follows established reproducibility guidance.
registered_in: Data availability section of the CROSS-MORSE manuscript

items.requirement: Every experiment behind a reported table or figure has its producing code in the repository: the lifecycle runtime, the auxiliary experiment drivers and the exporters that turn their outputs into traced records.
Smoke, pilot and full configurations of all seven datasets and the configurations of every auxiliary experiment.
The numerical data behind every reported table and figure, generated from the published measured outputs (paper/source_data/), and the provider datasets through the adapters.
The registered split rules and seeds of every configuration and the role memberships and seeds actually used by every reported run (manifests/registered/, manifests/published/).
Installable environment specifications and the observed execution environment of every reported run.
The trained checkpoints of every reported run, published with the repository's release.
The candidate, member and final predictions of every reported run.
The exploration trajectories of every reported run with their logged propensities.
The selection, confirmation, admission and evaluation records of every run, and every measurement-record set and campaign behind a reported display.
A generator for every numbered table and figure of the paper and supplement.

items.phrase: one-command reconstruction of every reported table and figure
items.requirement: `make paper` downloads and verifies the published outputs, rebuilds all numbered displays and compares every computed value with the printed one.
The machine-learning reproducibility checklist (Pineau et al.) mapped item by item to code and records (REPRODUCIBILITY.md).
